text: Scantlie Mab was a British folkloric figure. She served as an assistant to Habetrot, the spinning fairy. Scantlie Mab was an unattractive being with a hooked nose. She was admired for her devotion to her Otherworld mistress. She stood out for loyalty rather than for beauty. In the tale she gives the fairy court a worker figure with a ready duty. The record of her is brief, but the note of devotion stays constant. As a being of British folk tradition, she belongs to the circle of Habetrot, that spinning fairy who rewards diligence and honest toil.
